criteria.description: add(2, 3) returns 5 and add accepts negatives
UI visual proof: screenshot or Playwright headless journey artifact exists and is non-empty (required when task touches UI; delete this criterion when N/A)

_ui_note: If the task touches UI (frontend, HTML/CSS/JS pages, screenshots of a product surface): keep C-UI (or an equivalent criterion whose command opens a real screenshot file or runs a Playwright headless journey and fails if the evidence file is missing/empty). Delete C-UI when the task has no UI. Recipe: venv /tmp/pwvenv + playwright with executable_path=/usr/bin/google-chrome (no browser download).
